images. The models in specific often take inspiration from brainrot games, though this list will only list the brainrot both versions would be based on. {{scroll|text = **6 7 is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/67 67]. **Avocadini Antilopini is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Avocadini_Antilopini Avocadini Antilopini]. **Bambini Crostini is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Bambini_Crostini Bambini Crostini]. **Bandito Bobritto is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Bobrito_Bandito Bobrito Bandito]. The name in specific is swapped. **Bombardini Crocodilo is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Bombardiro_Crocodilo Bombardiro Crocodilo], though the first word uses an alternate spelling of it. **Boneca Ambalabu is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Boneca_Ambalabu Boneca Ambalabu]. **Br Br Batabim is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Brr_Brr_Patapim Brr Brr Patapim], though its name is altered slightly. **Brri Brri Bicus is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Bri_Bri_Bicus_Dicus_De_Bicus_De_Dicus Bri Bri Bicus Dicus De Bicus De Dicus]. **Cameloni Meleloni is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Cameloni_Meleloni Cameloni Meleloni]. **Cappoccino Assassino is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Cappuccino_Assassino Cappuccino Assassino]. **Chicleteira Bicicleteira is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Chicleteira_Bicicleteira Chicleteira Bicicleteira]. **Chimpanzini Bananini is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Chimpanzini_Bananini Chimpanzini Bananini]. **Cocofanto Elefanto is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Cocofanto_Elefanto Cocofanto Elefanto]. **Dolphinita is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Bananitta_Dolfinitta Bananitta Dolfinitta]. The name in Tower Defense Simulator appears to be taken from ''Steal a Brainrot'' though with Bananitta removed. **Fluri Flura is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Frulli_Frulla Frulli Frulla]. The name is an alternate name used for it, Fluriflura, but with a space after Fluri. **Frigo Camelo is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Frigo_Camelo Frigo Camelo]. **Gangster Footera is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Gangster_Footera Gangster Footera]. **Glorbo Fruitto Drillo is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Glorbo_Fruttodrillo Glorbo Fruttodrillo], though with a slightly altered name. **Gorillo Watermelondrillo is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Gorillo_Watermellondrillo Gorillo Watermellondrillo]. The name lacking one l in Watermellondrillo appears to be due to ''Steal a Brainrot'' spelling it the same way. **Hot Spot is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Pot_Hotspot Pot Hotspot], though with Pot removed and a space added between Hot and Spot. **Hot Spot Burittini is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Ayooo_My_Hotspot Ayooo My Hotspot]. The name used by it in Tower Defense Simulator appears to have been completely made up for the game or was taken from a Roblox brainrot game. **Job Job Sahur is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Job_Job_Job_Sahur Job Job Job Sahur], though one Job was removed from its name. **Karkirkurkarkarkar is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Karkirkurkarkarkarkurkurkur Karkirkurkarkarkarkurkurkur]. **Kiwi Bird appears to be based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Kiwi_Sahurus Kiwi Sahurus]. The name and specific design seems to originate from Roblox brainrot games. **Kiwi Pipi is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Pipi_Kiwi Pipi Kiwi], though the words in its name were swapped. **La Vaca Saturno is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Il_Bisonte_Giuppitere_Giuppitercito Il Bisonte Giuppitere Giuppitercito]. The name appears to be so different due to it being confused with [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/La_Vacca_Saturno_Saturnita La Vacca Saturno Saturnita]. **La Vacca Saturno Saturnita is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/La_Vacca_Saturno_Saturnita La Vacca Saturno Saturnita]. **Lioneli Cactusini is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Leonelli_Cactuselli Lioneli Cactusini]. The name appears to be based on a brainrot in ''Steal a Brainrot'' based on the same image. **Lirili Larila is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Lirili_Larila Lirili Larila]. **Melon Otter is most likely based on the [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Raccooni_Watermelunni Raccooni Watermelunni], as no known brainrot with an otter inside a watermelon exists. **Noobini Pizzanini is based on [[w:c:stealabrainrot:Noobini Pizzanini|Noobini Pizzanini]] from ''Steal a Brainrot''. **Nuclearini is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Centralucci_Nuclearucci Centralucci Nuclearucci], though its name was significantly altered. **Octopusini is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Blueberrinni_Octopussini Blueberrinni Octopussini], though Blueberrinni was removed from its name. **Orangutini Ananasini is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Orangutini_Ananasini Orangutini Ananasini]. **Pencile is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Pakrahmatmamamatmatmatmamatung Pakrahmatmamamatmatmatmamatung], though it has an entirely different name seemingly made for Tower Defense Simulator. **Pipe Man is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/To_To_To_Sahur To To To Sahur]. The name Pipe Man appears to come from various brainrot games on Roblox. **Sick Penguin is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Salamino_Penguino Salamino Penguino]. The name appears to have been completely made up for Tower Defense Simulator or taken from a Roblox brainrot game. **Strawberry Elefant is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Strawberry_Elephant Strawberry Elephant], but with a slightly different spelling of elephant. **Svinino is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Svinino_Bombondino Svinino Bombondino]. **TV Worldini is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Masonicticotive_Telepen_Planetmarsio Masonicticotive Telepen Planetmarsio]. The name is completely off and appears to have been taken from brainrot games on Roblox. **Talpa Di Ferro is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Talpa_di_Ferro Talpa di Ferro], but its name is capitalized differently. **Tim Cheese is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Tim_Cheese Tim Cheese]. **Tralalero Tralala is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Tralalero_Tralala Tralalero Tralala]. **Tric Trac Baraboom is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Tric_Trac_Baraboom Tric Trac Baraboom]. **Trippi Troppi is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Trippi_Troppi Trippi Troppi]. **Trulimero Truli is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Trulimero_Trulichina Trulimero Trulichina], though the second word was cut in half. **Tu Tu Tu Sahur is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Tu_Tu_Tu_Sahur Tu Tu Tu Sahur]. **Tung Tung Tung Sahur is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Tung_Tung_Tung_Sahur Tung Tung Tung Sahur]. **Udin Din Din Dun is based on [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/U_Din_Din_Din_Din_Dun_Ma_Din_Din_Din_Dun U Din Din Din Din Dun Ma Din Din Din Dun], though the name was cut down to just four words. }} ==Update History== *'''1 April 2026''' - [[v1.87.0]] **'''Brain Rot''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Brain Rot''' is disabled upon reviving. *'''2 April 2026''' - [[v1.87.0|v1.87.3a]] **'''Brain Rot''' removed. {{ModifierNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Brain Rot}}
